page: Microsoft Azure E16ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running under Microsoft Hyper-V. The instance provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped across 8 physical cores at 3.7 GHz, utilizing two threads per core. Memory capacity totals 128.0 GB, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. High-speed local scratch capacity is provisioned via an integrated 945 GB NVMe solid-state drive, while graphics processing units are absent.

Benchmark testing shows strong single-threaded performance, with Geekbench single-core reaching 1970.0 and stress-ng single-core achieving 3080.08, both ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core throughput aligns with expectations for 8 physical cores, registering 11455.0 on Geekbench multi-core and 24643.48 on stress-ng multi-core. Cryptographic and vector extension workloads benefit from hardware-supported AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI flags. Memory benchmarks demonstrate high cached small-block throughput at 1216.46 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read bandwidth drops to 37.92 GB/sec.

Architectural tradeoffs center around memory density and storage integration versus sustained multi-core parallel scaling. The instance delivers high single-thread efficiency and dedicated NVMe storage, making it cost-efficient for memory-dependent applications without requiring dedicated GPU acceleration or bare-metal hypervisor costs. However, large model AI inference shows steep performance falloffs, with 70B prompt processing settling in the bottom 10% at 4.46 tokens/sec.

This server profile suits relational and in-memory databases such as Redis, which achieved 22.31 million SET operations per second in testing. The combined 128 GB memory footprint and 945 GB NVMe scratch drive also support enterprise resource planning backends, text processing pipelines, Clang software builds, and mid-tier analytics engines requiring consistent per-core RAM allocations.
description: Microsoft Azure E16ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor clocked at 3.7 GHz. Configured with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores, it supplies 128.0 GB of memory alongside an integrated 945 GB local NVMe SSD. The architecture features extensive instruction support including AVX-512, SHA-NI, and VAES. Benchmark evaluations highlight top-quartile single-core processing capabilities, marked by a Geekbench score of 1970.0, and stable multi-core throughput reaching 11455.0. Although large-block uncached memory read bandwidth is constrained, small-block cached throughput and Redis operations perform reliably at scale. The 8 GB per vCPU allocation and fast local NVMe storage deliver strong resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive duties without the overhead of GPU hardware. Azure E16ads_v6 is well suited for hosting in-memory caches, relational database workloads, software compilation, and data analytics pipelines requiring significant temporary disk storage.
